summary: Edition 9 of our Black Book Catalogue celebrates 18 years with a bold new direction and over 16 new product lines including sculptural italian-made centrepieces, new colour palettes, small bathroom heroes and the very latest in vortex flush performance.
title: New Catalogue Out Now - Our Boldest Release Yet!
bodyHtml:
The New Happy Hour Series

The Black Book 9 has Arrived

Our latest edition ushers in a new era of bathroom design — Edition 9 reintroduces our iconic catalogue with a bold new direction and our most ambitious product release to date.

Inside, you'll find 16 new product lines, from sculptural Italian-made centrepieces, new colour palettes and small bathroom heroes to the latest in Vortex flush performance.


The All New Black Book Edition 9

Download Catalogue

A Bold New Era for Bathrooms

Curated for the design-conscious, this collection brings together distinct perspectives on form, materiality and function—each series a response to the evolving language of contemporary bathroom design.

From bold silhouettes to quietly refined essentials, these new arrivals continue our commitment to design integrity, craftsmanship and everyday usability.


Idilla Circle & Structure in Matte Sand

Idilla

A poetic reinterpretation of ceramic tradition. Idilla blends thick, sculptural edges with refined detailing, offering a contemporary yet timeless aesthetic.


Idilla Oval & Structure in Matte Black

Futura Vortex Flush

Minimalist in appearance, powerful in performance. The multi design award-winning Futura series delivers near-silent Vortex flushing and exceptional water efficiency—crafted in Italy, celebrated worldwide.


Futura's multi-award winning Vortex Flush

Monolith Vortex Flush

Designed and engineered by Olympia Ceramica, Monolith pairs architectural restraint with the latest in silent vortex flush technology. A bold, yet minimalist statement in both form and function.


Futura's multi-award winning Vortex Flush

Happy Hour Series

Compact, sculptural, and full of character. Happy Hour redefines small space versatility with expressive design and everyday practicality.

Hyde Series

Simplicity, sculpted. Hyde distills contemporary design into gentle curves and essential lines, offered in a versatile range of toilets and basins.


New Hyde Series

Download your Copy

Download your copy to explore our all new design developments and product launches—presented in rich, full-colour detail and curated to inspire your next project.
